svg.title: Darb, my personal project
svg.desc: Darb is mine, not something I built for an employer. The name means path in Arabic. Lama, my co-founder, and I started it from nothing, and I engineered the whole platform myself, from the database up. People search it for local businesses, friends add the places missing from their towns, and the businesses run their own pages on it. Right now it covers the north of Israel. I want it in every town in the country, and then beyond.
